header.about: minFill capping n (16 and 3 USD), with one uncapped contrast

run.pd0: input.reference of each vector: the decision prices one cycle before tick 0 (null = nan: the leg has no reference). It gives `last`; `entry` is the first tick price
run.Pe: the decision prices (Pe values fills only; no decision reads it)

perLeg.variation: v = price / last - 1, unrounded; null when the leg has no price or no previous price (nan in the engine)
perLeg.entry: rule 9's base price: the leg's first tick with a price; null before it. Never the reference
perLeg.protected: price <= entry x (1 - threshold); false without a price. Reported in the soft window too, where it no longer blocks
perLeg.inBand: the stable leg only: not(|price - 1| + band_add > band); null without a stable leg or without its price
perLeg.reason: picked = at least one fill on the tick; complete / no_price / band / rule9 = the engine's why_not; cooldown = eligible, not picked, and first in the rule 4 order until rule 5 sent it to the back of the line; not_due = eligible and not picked for any other reason (nothing due, or the chunks due went to legs ahead of it)

vectors.notes: C=100, minFill 16: n capped to (1, 1, 3); calm, soft
C=250, minFill 16, daily maximum N: every leg capped; calm, soft
C=30, minFill 3 (canonical route): n capped to (3, 3, 3); calm, soft
C=1000, minFill 16, N=86: capped, M < N; calm, soft
C=20, minFill 16: every cap is max(1, 0) = 1; calm, soft
contrast to minfill-c1000-m16-n86: minFill 3 caps nothing, n is the Hamilton split of 86; calm, soft
